fact: On 26 August 2025 the Minister told the first Inter-Ministerial Committee meeting that about 84 projects stem from the Blueprint, that the Online Motor Vehicle Licence renewal flagship is already deployed and that e-health staff training has started, and that the Committee will report to Cabinet monthly.
title: Digital Transformation: First Meeting of Inter-Ministerial Committee
publisher: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (source GIS)
